title: docs(adr): the recycle bin — a separate store, restore under original ids, retention in days (#3146 slice 1)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ③ a split the parent needs, asked by `domain:server#4` (`Request: triage · #3146`). ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #3146 · Ruling-ref: 6629858351 (the recycle-bin shape, maintainer 「同意，企业版功能在 cloud 中立卡后续开发」)

## Wanted

An ADR, or an ADR-0049 amendment, for the new recycle-bin surface #3146 rules. It names the readers that will exist, because `enable.trash`, `softDelete`, `allowRestore` and `allowPurge` were removed in 16.0 under ADR-0049 when nothing read them. The new keys are new, not the tombstoned ones.

It records the ruled shape:
- a separate recycle-bin store, one entry per delete operation, with the cascade set snapshotted;
- restore under the original ids, and the refusals (unique taken, parent purged, package uninstalled);
- retention in days (default 30, `OS_RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS`) through a host resolver hook. The framework knows days, never plans (ADR-0012).

The v1 scope is the parent's.

**Order:** first. The spec slice (#3146 slice 2) cites this ADR.
